info.title: Payment Sandbox API
info.summary: A test-mode payment provider for developers. No real money, no real cards.
info.description:
Create hosted checkouts, simulate every payment outcome, save and charge **test** cards, and receive signed webhooks.

**Everything here is simulated.** Real card numbers are refused; no real payment provider is connected.

## Authentication
HTTP Basic: `Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)` with an API credential created in the dashboard. Send it over HTTPS only. Dashboard cookies are never accepted by the API.

## Conventions
- JSON in, JSON out; send `Content-Type: application/json` (max 64 KiB). Unknown request fields are rejected with `unknown_parameter`.
- Amounts are decimal strings (`"149.00"`) plus an integer `amount_minor`. Never floats.
- Lists are newest first and use cursors: `limit` (1-100, default 10) and `starting_after` (an id from the previous page); `has_more` tells you whether to continue.
- Errors always have the shape of the `Error` schema. Branch on `error.code`, never on `message`.
- Rate limit: per account per minute, reported in `X-RateLimit-*` headers; `429` carries `Retry-After`.
- Idempotency: send `Idempotency-Key` on any create call you may retry (required for `POST /payments`).
- API version: `2026-11-01`, also written into every event as `api_version`. Responses may gain fields; ignore the ones you do not know.

## Webhooks
Events (`checkout.session.completed`, `checkout.session.expired`, `checkout.session.cancelled`, `payment.pending`, `payment.succeeded`, `payment.failed`, `payment.cancelled`, `payment_method.created`, `payment_method.updated`, `payment_method.default_updated`, `payment_method.disabled`, `payment_method.deleted`, `webhook_endpoint.test`) are POSTed to your endpoints with a `Sandbox-Signature` header; see the `webhooks` section below and the webhook guide for verification.

post.description: Creates a hosted checkout. Send `amount` and `currency` for a payment session, or `mode: "setup"` with a `customer` to let a payer save a test card. The response `url` is where you send the payer; it is returned only once. Setting `scenario` fixes the outcome of the payment (see the guide). Repeating a request with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the original response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1-255 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -. A retry with the same key and body returns the original response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different body is `422 idempotency_key_reused`.

201.description: The session. A payment session has `amount`; a setup session has `mode: "setup"`.

400.description:
Error. `error.code` is one of:

- `invalid_json`: The body is empty, is not valid JSON or is not a JSON object.
- `invalid_parameter`: A parameter failed validation. `param` names it and `message` says why.
- `unknown_parameter`: The request contains a parameter this endpoint does not accept. Unknown parameters are rejected, never ignored.
- `unsupported_currency`: The currency is not in the supported list.
- `invalid_amount_format`: `amount` is not a decimal string such as "149.00".
- `too_many_decimals`: `amount` has more decimal places than the currency allows.
- `amount_too_small`: `amount` is below the minimum.
- `amount_too_large`: `amount` is above the maximum.
- `invalid_idempotency_key`: `Idempotency-Key` must be 1-255 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -.

post.description:
We POST each event to every enabled endpoint subscribed to its type. Respond `2xx` within 10 seconds. Anything else is retried with exponential backoff (see the webhook guide); delivery is **at least once** and unordered, so deduplicate on `Sandbox-Event-Id`.

**Verify the signature on the raw body bytes** before parsing: `v1 = hex(HMAC-SHA256(key = your whsec_ secret, message = t + "." + raw_body))`. Accept if any `v1` matches (two are sent for 24 hours after a rotation) and `t` is within 300 seconds of now.
